text:
jia: Hey team — proposing a small TF change: add an ephemeral GPU spot nodepool for burst jobs with a short TTL and capacity reservation fallback. Posting what I'm planning so we can catch any secrets/taint issues before I open the PR.

mike: SGTM, can you paste the snippet? wondering about taints + tolerations for on-demand fallback.

jia: Sure — current sketch:
```
module "gpu_spot_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra-modules.git//eks/nodegroup"
  name = "gpu-spot-ephemeral"
  instance_types = ["p4d.24xlarge", "g5.48xlarge"]
  capacity_type = "SPOT"
  capacity_reservation = "best-effort" # provider knob we use for short holds
  ttl_minutes = 30
  taints = { "redwood/gpu_spot" = "true:NoSchedule" }
  labels = { pool = "ephemeral-spot" }
  kubelet_bootstrap_secret = var.kubelet_spot_secret_arn
}
```
Note: `kubelet_bootstrap_secret` will be an ARN to the bootstrap cert stored in KMS; I plan to wire it through our secrets module which puts it in SSM and mounts via `k8s serviceAccount -> projected secret`.

laura: Quick question: are we expecting preemption events to be handled by the DaemonSet or by the cluster-autoscaler? We should make sure the NodeTerminationHandler has the right IAM and the pod tolerations.

mike: We run node-termination-handler as a DaemonSet already for spot. Add toleration in burst job manifests like:
```
tolerations:
- key: "redwood/gpu_spot"
  operator: "Exists"
  effect: "NoSchedule"
```
And add `nodeSelector: { pool: "ephemeral-spot" }` to the job template.

sam: For secrets wiring: don't put KMS ARNs directly in TF remote state outputs accessible by devs. Use the secrets module to create an SSM parameter with kms: true and then grant read access to the node IAM role. That way the kubelet can pull during bootstrap via SSM GetParameter with decryption.

jia: Good point. Plan: secrets module creates /redwood/prod/gpu/bootstrap/spot and sets kms_key_id = var.bootstrap_kms. TF change will reference module secret's ssm_path, not the raw ARN.

infra-bot: Reminder: any change touching node IAM or secrets requires an oncall review and infra-secrets approval per policy.

laura: Also ensure the autoscaler has a fallback rule: if spot pool can't fulfill, fall back to `gpu-on-demand` nodepool. We have that policy in `cluster/autoscaler/scale-policies.tf` — add the new pool to the prioritized list.

mike: One more nit: TTL 30m might be too short for long-running evals. Maybe 60m and have the burst job set `activeDeadlineSeconds` accordingly. We can experiment.

jia: Ok I'll change TTL to 60m and update autoscaler policy. I'll open a PR with the TF diff + example k8s job snippet. @sam @laura can you do a quick secret/iam check after I open? :thumbsup:

sam: will do, ping me when PR is up.

laura: ack, will skim IAM bits.

infra-bot: New PR required: infra/eks #4127 — apply-review checklist triggered.
